prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Pearland, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1384; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This is a recorded statement regarding the collision you were involved in. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state your full name and the address where you currently live.

A: [Claimant name] and I live at [address] in Pearland, Texas.

Q: Thank you. Can you walk me through what happened at the intersection?

A: I was driving east and wanted to turn left into the shopping center. I had a green arrow, or at least I thought I did. I started into the turn and a car coming from the other direction hit the front driver's side of my vehicle.

Q: Was the other vehicle going straight or turning?

A: It was coming straight through. I didn't see it until it was almost on me. I was looking for oncoming traffic gaps, so I may have been focused on the wrong lane.

Q: Were you injured in the collision?

A: Yes. My neck snapped forward and then back. I felt stiffness right away, and by the next morning it was sore to turn my head to the left.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or received any treatment since the accident?

A: I went to urgent care that same afternoon. They diagnosed a neck strain and gave me a muscle relaxer and a referral to physical therapy. I have been going to therapy twice a week.

Q: Did you have any pain or stiffness in your neck before this accident?

A: No, not that I can recall. I had no issues with my neck before this.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I want to make sure my medical bills and the repairs to my car are covered. I have been missing some work because of the pain.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
